children: INNOVATE reported several post-transaction steps tied to its Broadcasting segment disposition and capital structure. The company extended the maturity of its MSD Credit Agreement to December 31, 2026, enhancing near-term liquidity. INNOVATE also executed a Limited Liability Company Agreement to govern HC2 Broadcasting Holdings LLC with CONX Broadcast, setting a three-member board and minority protections. In connection with the merger closing, the $105 million bridge loan was extinguished and the related New Loan Agreement was terminated, simplifying the balance sheet.
